notes:
**`--format junit` no longer reports "could not measure" as green.**

Docket withholds its site-wide conclusions when a crawl saw too little of a
site to support them — "no analytics anywhere", "no structured data anywhere" —
and the report says so in as many words: they are not passes, they are unknown.

The JUnit output said otherwise. Unless a crawl read literally nothing, every
withheld check appeared in the CI panel as a passing test. On a crawl covering
0.4% of a site, twelve conclusions were withheld and the panel reported 98
tests, one failure, nothing skipped.

Those checks are now marked skipped, with the reason, and the number matches
what the report says. A check that genuinely ran and found nothing is still a
pass — that is what makes the report legible.
